name: Regimental
description: Repp stripes raked on the bias, each broad band its own color, with a fine contrasting line running between every pair.

code.style: --rule: ( --d: @pd(@m(@calc(@X - 1), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; width: 150%; top: 34%; height: 32%; background-color: @p(@var(--d)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; width: 150%; top: 12.6%; height: 74.8%; background-color: var(--color5); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 5.3%, transparent 5.3% 94.7%, #000 94.7%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 5.3%, transparent 5.3% 94.7%, #000 94.7%); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
